name: pg_nanotime
abstract: Nanosecond-precision timestamp types and clocks for PostgreSQL
description: pg_nanotime provides nanotimestamptz (16 bytes, full PostgreSQL range), nanotimestamptz8 (8 bytes, int64 Unix ns, 1677-2262), nanotimestamp (without time zone) and nanointerval, range types nanotstzrange/nanotsrange (with multiranges, GiST and exclusion constraints), with B-tree/hash/BRIN support, arithmetic, time_bucket_ns, date_trunc, extract_ns, now_ns()/statement_ns()/clock_ns() clocks, per-backend and cross-backend strictly increasing clocks, timestamp9 migration helpers and TimescaleDB helpers.

pg_nanotime.abstract: Types nanotimestamptz, nanotimestamptz8, nanotimestamp, nanointerval, nanotstzrange, nanotsrange and nanosecond clocks
